This is the wildest thing on the channel and I'm a bit proud of that.

Glitching synth arpeggios, neon bass pulses, and a kick that's been pushed until it snarls. It doesn't build up to anything, it's already going when you walk in, and it doesn't stop to think for two minutes twenty.

I've played this back more than anything else this month, and the drop at 0:32 still gets me in the knees every time.

It's a rawstyle kick with a tail so long it's basically the bassline, a reverse bass that keeps pulling the floor out from under you, and screeching lead stabs on top. It goes: first drop 0:32, falls away at 1:06, back at 1:22, drops out again at 1:50, and then 2:00 is the one. Two and a half minutes, no fat on it.

I kept it for what it does to a room. There's a moment where a crowd stops standing and starts moving as one thing, and I wanted a track that forces that moment.

Play it loud, in company, when the night needs pulling together.

Which one got you, 0:32 or 2:00? Tell me in the comments, I read every one.
